```{r}
library(terra)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
```


```{r}
dat<-read_csv(here("raw_data/offshore_infrastructure_v20231106.csv"))

wind<-dat %>% 
  mutate(wind = ifelse(label %in% c("possible_wind", "probable_wind", "wind"), 1, 0)) %>% 
  select(lat, lon, wind)
```

```{r}
table(dat$label)
table(wind$wind)
```

# This plots points, which may be good enough but should be easy to convert to raster
```{r}
wind_sf = st_as_sf(wind, coords = c("lon", "lat"), 
                 crs = 4326)


```

# Turn sf points into raster

```{r}

r <- wind_sf|>
  terra::vect() |>
  terra::rast()

terra::values(r) <- wind_sf$wind
terra::plot(r)

wind2<-wind %>% 
  select(lon, lat, wind) %>% 
  rename(x = lon,
         y = lat,
         z = wind) %>% 
  as.data.frame(.)

wind_ras<-rast(wind2, crs = "EPGS:4326", type="xyz", digits = 2)
wind_ras<-rasterfromXYZ(wind_latlon)
```
